When the money left in the bank started running out, I went to look for a job. Went to a call center, the manager spoke in English, I was silent. He said 'We need someone who can speak English.' I came back. Then went to my daughters' school, the form was in English. The teacher made a strange face when I asked to explain in Hindi. That day I realized if I don't learn English, my daughters will also be left behind. One night, saw the SpeakEasy app ad on my phone. ₹1 trial. Thought what is there to lose in ₹1? Downloaded it. At night, after putting all five daughters to sleep, I practiced with the Vani AI coach. The house would be silent and I would say to my teacher on the phone 'I am calling about the job opening. My name is Zara.' The AI coach corrected my mistakes 100 times but never mocked me. This time, looking straight into his eyes, I said 'Sir, I have improved my English. I would like another chance.' The manager was surprised, but I got the job. Today, it has been 3 years and I earn 34,000 a month. English gave me a job, the job gave money, and money gave respect. Now when the teacher speaks in English, I reply in English. My daughters look at me and smile. My father now comes and says it was a mistake, but now I don't look for anyone's support. I am my daughters' shield myself. Download the SpeakEasy app. Watch experts' videos, practice with the Vani AI coach. Just 15 minutes daily, after putting the kids to sleep.
